presentation.name: See what a connection swap breaks, and prove the numbers
presentation.summary: Works out what in a Power BI model will not survive a warehouse connection swap, and proves the report still returns the same numbers afterwards.
benefits: Takes the baseline and the inventory while the old connection still answers
Names the rebind that does not announce itself: a column matches by name and the number moves
Treats DAX as stable across warehouses, and M, types, date tables, and folded SQL as the parts that are not
Checks whether a step still folds by the SQL the connector sends, rather than by assuming the new warehouse folds the same M
Requires the proof below the headline total, where two errors stop cancelling
Stops at the model, and leaves warehouse redesign as separate work
